initial_states: six section points (q1, v1) whose passive orbits stay in bounded regions and visit 3-7% of the cells in 5000 s (scan_passive.py)
note: Gains, horizon and initial states were chosen in four steps on 15 Nov 2026, each after the previous figure was seen (mixed starts; regular starts; bounded passive orbits with the gain 0.001 added and 100 dropped; then the half-decade gains 0.003, 0.03, 0.3 added and 10 dropped). The initial states were selected from the passive scan only. Not a preregistered study.
